shortdesc.ph: Used to configure built-in encryption parameters.

plentry.pd: Built-in encryption mode. See . Agora recommends using AES_128_GCM2 or AES_256_GCM2, which support encryption salt for enhanced security.

Encryption key in string format, with no length limit. Agora recommends using a 32-byte key. If the encryption key is not set or is set to , built-in encryption cannot be used, and the SDK will return -2.
Salt used for encryption, 32 bytes in length. This parameter takes effect only in AES_128_GCM2 or AES_256_GCM2 encryption modes. In this case, make sure this parameter is not 0.

Whether to enable data stream encryption:
: Enable data stream encryption.
: (Default) Disable data stream encryption.

Encryption key as a string with no length limit. Agora recommends using a 32-byte key. If the encryption key is not set or set to null, built-in encryption cannot be used, and the SDK returns -2.

Salt used for encryption, 32 bytes in length. Agora recommends generating this salt on the server side using OpenSSL. See Media Stream Encryption. This parameter is only effective when using AES_128_GCM2 or AES_256_GCM2. In this case, ensure the value is not 0.

Whether to enable data stream encryption:
: Enables data stream encryption.
: (default) Does not enable data stream encryption.
